We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 5 reactions for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have identified a template for deprotecting TBS (template 29646) which breaks TBS protecting group. Applying it gave three possible precursors: each with TBS still attached? Actually the product is target; applying template gave precursors where TBS is attached to oxygen? Wait template is reverse: retro template removes TBS? The retro template: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So applying to target (with OH) gives precursor with TBS attached. Indeed result includes three precursors with Si group attached. So step 1 (retro) is deprotection: target -> TBS-protected precursor.

Now we need further steps to reach simpler building blocks, total 5 steps.

We also have template 682444 which seems to be a HWE (Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons) forming double bond and ester? It broke something to give two fragments: one fragment is C/C(=C/... )CO and other is CCO (ethanol). That seems to be a retro HWE: product (ester) -> aldehyde + phosphonate? Actually the retro template gave product (our target?) Not sure.

Our target after deprotection still has a TBS group on one OH. The rest includes a side chain with conjugated diene and a terminal carboxylic acid (C(O)=O). The side chain also has a primary alcohol (CO) attached to the diene (C=C(CO)/C). So we need to think of disconnections: maybe the carboxylic acid derived from HWE (still present). The primary alcohol could be from DIBAL reduction of ester? Actually DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde, not alcohol. But we have primary alcohol attached to double bond (allylic alcohol). Could be from reduction of aldehyde (by NaBH4) but not in hints.

Given hints: TBS protection, HWE, DIBAL-H, TMSOTf, Still-Gennari. We need 5 steps, likely: 1) deprotect TBS (retro). 2) remove TMS? Not present. Maybe the TBS-protected precursor still has TBS; we need to disconnect the side chain via HWE (retro) to give aldehyde and phosphonate. Then DIBAL reduction of ester to aldehyde? Actually HWE forms double bond from aldehyde + phosphonate, so retro would break C=C and give aldehyde + phosphonate. Our target has double bond conjugated to carboxylic acid; that could be product of HWE between aldehyde (maybe from earlier) and phosphonate bearing carboxylate? Not sure.

Simplify: maybe propose route:

Step1 (retro): Remove TBS protecting group -> gives TBS-protected intermediate (precursor A) with Si group.

Step2 (retro): Apply Still-Gennari (Z-HWE) to break the C=C between the diene and the carboxylic acid, giving aldehyde fragment (fragment B) and phosphonate fragment (fragment C). But we need template for Still-Gennari; not found yet.

Search for Still-Gennari template.
